title: AutoStep
description: It allows players to walk smoothly across entire blocks without jumping
body:
🪜 AutoStep

Smooth and seamless movement for your server!

Version: 1.0 | Compatibility: 1.20.5+ (and forks)

🎮 Support Discord

--- Tired of Minecraft’s clunky auto-jump and players getting stuck on carpets, slabs, and small blocks? **AutoStep** is a lightweight movement enhancement plugin that allows players to smoothly walk up obstacles without the awkwardness of vanilla movement. Built for modern Minecraft versions, **AutoStep** uses native attributes for a seamless, lag-free experience with optional WorldGuard integration and fully configurable behavior. --- ## ✨ Main Features ### 🚀 Smooth and Natural Movement Let your players move comfortably around the server without needing to jump over every small obstacle: * Walk smoothly over full blocks, slabs, carpets, and map details. * Much more comfortable than vanilla auto-jump. --- ## 💻 Commands and Permissions | Command | Description | Permission | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `/autostep` | Toggles your own smooth step. | `autostep.use` | | `/autostep ` | Toggles smooth step for another player. | `autostep.admin` | | `/autostep reload` | Reloads the configuration file. | `autostep.admin` | --- ## ⚙️ Configuration ```yaml # ========================================== # AutoStep Configuration # ========================================== settings: # Height when the plugin is activated. # 1.0 = One full block. # 1.25 = Recommended for maps with many carpets and slabs. step_height_active: 1.25 # Default Minecraft Vanilla height. step_height_vanilla: 0.6 # Should AutoStep be automatically enabled when a player joins the server? enable_on_join: false # Enable WorldGuard integration? (Respects the 'autostep' custom flag) use_worldguard: true messages: prefix: "&8[&eAutoStep&8] " enabled: "&aSmooth step enabled! You will now walk over obstacles." disabled: "&cSmooth step disabled! You have returned to normal movement." enabled_other: "&aSmooth step enabled for &e%player%&a." disabled_other: "&cSmooth step disabled for &e%player%&c." no_permission: "&cYou do not have permission to use this command." only_players: "&cThis command can only be executed by players." player_not_found: "&cPlayer not found or offline." reloaded: "&aConfiguration successfully reloaded." ``` --- ## 📦 Installation 1. Ensure your server is running **Paper/Spigot 1.20.5 or higher** 2. Download the `AutoStep.jar` file 3. Place it inside your server's `plugins/` folder 4. Install **WorldGuard** *(optional)* 5. Restart your server to generate the configuration file --- ## ✅ Compatibility * Minecraft `1.20.5+` * Paper * Spigot * Modern forks --- ## 💬 Support Thank you for downloading **AutoStep**. If you have any issues, suggestions, or bug reports, join our **[Discord server](https://discord.gg/WHBWBWWYDq)** and I’ll help you as soon as possible.
